title: Worker-link test files always exit; find why they time out on Windows
goal: No worker-link test file can hold the test process alive after its tests end or time out, and the Windows worker-link tests stop timing out
acceptance: A committed test fails on main: a worker-link test cancelled at its timeout (mid-fixture and with links connected) leaves its file process running
Fixture teardown always runs (test hooks), each close is bounded, and WorkerLink.stop() and Runtime.close() end even mid-operation
The Windows cost of the worker-link tests is measured and reduced without weakening what they prove
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 when opened from run 45307748925: reproduce, fix teardown, measure Windows. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-26.
